_comment: Real retailers and products, imported with `pnpm db:import-sources`.
Retailers listed here were reviewed on 2026-09-20 against their robots.txt:
see TCG Market Project/docs/scanner-source-review.md for the evidence.
eBay (web), Walmart (web), Star City Games and the Bandai Namco Store explicitly
disallow the search paths the scanner used, and Amazon and TCGplayer were dropped
on terms-of-service grounds, so none of them appear here.
CoolStuffInc and Premium Bandai are listed but disabled: both permit us in
robots.txt, but neither serves data we can lawfully read. See their notes.
Product set codes, UPCs and MSRPs are deliberately null until confirmed from a

retailers.name: CoolStuffInc
retailers.note: Robots permits the search page (Allow: /), but results are not server-rendered: the page returns only chrome and the data loads from /ajax, which their robots.txt DOES disallow. Off until they server-render results or publish a feed. robotsOk stays true because that is what their robots.txt says.

retailers.name: Miniature Market
retailers.note: Crawl-delay: 10 is set; interval kept well above it.

retailers.name: Premium Bandai US
retailers.note: Robots permits the search path (they only disallow offset/limit/sortType parameters), but the URL returns ~238KB of obfuscated anti-bot challenge JavaScript instead of a storefront: empty title, no content. Reading it would mean defeating that protection, so it stays off. An official Bandai feed or API would be the way in. robotsOk stays true because that is what their robots.txt says.
